class.peasant.ETH: a peasant with an ancestral plot
class.slave.family.ETH: into a family of bonded servants (barya)
class.peasant.family.ETH: into a peasant family farming its ancestral land, the rist
class.craftsman.family.ETH: into a family of smiths or potters
class.trader.family.ETH: into a family of caravan merchants
class.landowner.family.ETH: into the family of a balabbat, granted by the king the right to collect dues from villages (gult)
class.noble.family.ETH: into a family of courtiers in the royal camp
class.landowner.harar: a family of garden and land owners
class.landowner.family.harar: into a family owning gardens and fields outside Harar
class.noble.harar: a family of the emir's circle
class.noble.family.harar: into a family close to the sultan and the emir
prof.farmer.desc.ETH: Teff, barley, beans, a pair of oxen and a maresha plough. Part of the harvest goes to the lord and the church.
prof.laborer.desc.ETH: No land of your own: you reap, carry and build for food and a couple of salt bars.
prof.artisan.desc.ETH: Nobody can live without ploughshares, sickles and pots, yet smiths and potters are feared and kept at a distance.
prof.weaver.desc.ETH: You spin cotton into fine thread. Men usually weave the white shamma cloth, but without your thread there is no loom.
prof.midwife.desc.ETH: You deliver babies and know herbs and prayers. Any house may call you, any night.
prof.merchant.desc.ETH: Caravans of salt, cloth, iron and incense between the highlands and the coast. Many merchants are Muslims.
prof.soldier.as.ETH: a soldier of the royal army
prof.soldier.desc.ETH: Spear, shield and campaigns with the royal camp. Paid in land, plunder and the right to be fed by villages.
prof.soldier.desc.harar: Service to the emir and the imam: raids into the highlands, plunder and danger.
prof.scribe.desc.ETH: You write the king's chronicles, charters and inventories in Ge'ez. A pen can glorify a man or ruin him.
prof.scribe.desc.harar: You write merchants' contracts, the emir's letters and records of debts in Arabic.
prof.physician.desc.ETH: Herbs, bloodletting, cautery and books of remedies. You are paid in grain, honey and salt.
prof.priest.desc.ETH: You serve before the tabot in the village church, baptise, marry and bury. Priests may marry and plough like everyone else.
prof.priest.desc.harar: You lead prayer at the mosque, teach children the Qur'an and settle disputes by sharia.
prof.landholder.desc.ETH: The king granted you the right to collect dues from villages. In return you bring soldiers and feed the court when it passes.
prof.landholder.desc.harar: Gardens, fields and hired hands around the city. Your income comes from harvests and trade.
prof.magistrate.desc.ETH: The king has made you dejazmach or shum of a province. Great power, which one word can take away.
prof.magistrate.desc.harar: You rule a district in the sultan's name: taxes, justice, soldiers.
prof.matron.as.ETH: the lady of a great house
prof.matron.desc.ETH: You run a noble household: servants, stores of teff and honey, feasts, matchmaking and land disputes.
prof.household_slave.desc.ETH: You grind grain, fetch water and bake injera. You are not free, but the household knows you by name.
prof.field_slave.desc.ETH: Hard work on someone else's land from dawn to dark.
prof.officer.desc.ETH: You lead the vanguard of the royal army. Honour, land, and the first blow of every battle.
prof.workshop_owner.desc.ETH: Your own forge or pottery, apprentices and orders from the church and the court.
prof.official.desc.ETH: You manage the court's affairs: judgements, the camp's supplies, land charters.
prof.overseer.desc.ETH: Your master has trusted you with the house and the other servants. You are still not free, but your word carries weight.
prof.debtera.desc: A church scholar: you sing in the choir with sistrum and prayer staff, copy books, compose qene verses and write healing scrolls.
prof.monk.desc: A monastery on a mountain or an island, fasting, prayer and work. You live on alms and respect.
prof.icon_painter.desc: You paint the Virgin Mary, Saint George and the angels on panels and church walls, grinding your own pigments.
prof.coffee_merchant.desc: You buy beans from the gardens around Harar and send them with caravans to the sea at Zeila.
prof.salt_carrier.desc: You lead caravans with amole salt bars from the scorching lowlands up to the highlands. Here, salt is money.
prof.church_carver.desc: You cut churches straight out of the rock, from the top down, with no room for mistakes.
prof.beta_israel_smith.as: a smith or potter of the Beta Israel
prof.beta_israel_smith.desc: Your community has almost no land, but skilled hands. Christians buy your ploughshares and pots, yet keep their distance.
cause.eth_road: died on the road with a caravan
lifestyle.food.plain.desc.ETH: Teff injera and a stew of beans and lentils. No meat or milk during fasts
lifestyle.food.varied.desc.ETH: Meat after the fasts, butter, honey, milk and cheese
lifestyle.food.feasts.desc.ETH: Fresh meat, tej in horns, guests and singers. Costly and honourable
lifestyle.exercise.gymnasium.desc.ETH: Gugs, a mounted game with javelins, and hunting in the valleys. Stronger and healthier
lifestyle.medicine.temple.desc.ETH: Springs at churches and monasteries, prayers and vows
lifestyle.medicine.physician.desc.ETH: A healer versed in herbs and books of remedies looks after the family. Costly
lifestyle.baths.rarely.desc.ETH: A stream and a jar of water
lifestyle.baths.sometimes.desc.ETH: On feast days and after a fast
lifestyle.baths.daily.desc.ETH: Every day, as custom and faith ask. You need water nearby and means
focus.learn.desc.ETH: Church school: the fidel alphabet and the Psalter by heart. The teacher is paid in grain and honey
focus.study.desc.ETH: Ge'ez books, church chant, qene verse and commentary. Costs money
focus.rest.desc.ETH: Feast days, tej, talk with the neighbours
focus.religion.desc.harar: Mosque, prayer, the Ramadan fast, alms
focus.learn.desc.harar: Qur'an school: Arabic letters and suras by heart
focus.service.desc.ETH: Spear, shield, horse and campaigns with the army
religion.judaism.ETH: the faith of the Beta Israel
religion.judaism.desc.ETH: The Beta Israel community: the Torah in Ge'ez, the Sabbath, strict purity, their own monks and prayer houses.
religion.african_traditional.desc.shewa: The sky god, spirits of the ancestors and the land, elders and the rites of the clan.
